study: Tape-only fix: stop refusing arms on IEX print gaps that are normal for the name. Operator 2026-10-14 ('concerned about not many opens').
registered_at: 2026-10-14 ~12:15 ET, before the knobs ran on any session.
evidence: 10/14 09:45-11:47: tape_only = 19% of 3,050 arm refusals; print age behind them p25 33 s, median 45 s, p75 65 s, even on GME (median 54 s) and CTSH (36 s). The fixed ceiling is 15 s (ai_watch_decision_max_age_sec) and the quote fallback needs an IEX quote <= 5 s old (QUOTE_MAX_AGE_SEC).
knobs: ai_watch_tape_gap_mult (per-name ceiling = mult x median gap of the name's own prints, >= 5 gaps seen, capped at ai_watch_tape_gap_max_sec), ai_watch_quote_max_age_sec, ai_watch_quote_print_max_age_sec. All default to today's behaviour.
why_not_replay: replay_session.py does not see live stale-tape states (replay-session-runs-live-code: precision 0.14 because live refuses on stale tape the replay never sees), so this is a live forward check, not a replay arm.
forward_read: after 5 sessions: (1) tape_only share of arm refusals vs 10/14's 19%; (2) opens per 10 minutes vs 10/14 after 10:35 (1.4); (3) SAFETY: entries armed on a print older than 15 s - their fill minus the decision price, in bp, vs entries armed on a fresh print. If the stale-armed fills average >= 5 bp worse than fresh-armed (day-clustered t >= 2), or their 10-min markout is worse by >= 10 bp, switch the knobs back off.
